column1: # Size, offset and particle speed of the enchant glow, per weapon shape.
# Applied by tools\client\tune_enchant_glow.ps1 to every weapongrp row whose
# effect is an EnchantGlow rung. See docs/enchant-glow.md.
# key     what it matches                            wins over
# id:266  one weapon, by its weapongrp id            everything
# With no "*" row - as here - only the weapons named below are written, and every other glowing
# row keeps the numbers weapongrp already carries.
# offX/offY/offZ move the effect in the weapon's own axes, in Unreal units:
#   X  along the blade   (+ towards the tip)
# scale is the size of the effect, 1 being the size it was authored at ; over 3
# is enormous. velocity is how fast its particles travel - lower is a tighter,
# calmer glow, higher throws them further out.
# On two-handed-mesh weapons (fists, dual swords) the same row goes to both hands.
# key    offX   offY   offZ   scale   velocity
